description: Records this session's transcript_path at start so /save-conversation can find it reliably (#23), and logs every tool call so `enchiridion tool-call-stats` can report the cost of a run (#100). Both fail open (#153): `|| exit 0` keeps a failed binary bootstrap — or any other error — from interrupting the session, at the cost of that hook's side effect for this run. PostToolUse additionally sets ENCHIRIDION_NO_FETCH, since it fires on every tool call and must never re-attempt a failing download hundreds of times a session; SessionStart is the one that warms the cache. That env prefix is POSIX-only, so on a cmd.exe host PostToolUse (cost telemetry) degrades while SessionStart (which /save-conversation depends on) still resolves bin/enchiridion.cmd via PATHEXT.
